verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or batch operation over many items, such as bulk-running selected evaluators, bulk editing, bulk deleting, or batch API endpoints. Marketing about running thousands of synthetic conversations, and features like cron schedules and metric sampling, are about scale or scheduling rather than multi-item bulk actions, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
